source: FIGURES.md adapted for clubs, 2026-09-24, as for the Tokyo, NYC, Amsterdam, Ibiza and Paris guides. Live Google SERP for 'best clubs in budapest' (US, 2026-09-24) read in full: Reddit r/budapest, Tripadvisor Attractions list, GetYourGuide, trip.com Top 20, budapestinfo.hu, reformatt.com. History and dates: A38's own history page; Wikipedia (A38 (venue), Szimpla Kert); We Love Budapest (Instant-Fogas merger and expansion, Corvintető closure and redevelopment); Electronic Beats (Lärm's opening and design); turbinabudapest.hu and We Love Budapest (Boiler Room Budapest at Turbina, 2021); Resident Advisor and boilerroom.tv (Boiler Room Budapest x Lobster Theremin at Akvárium Klub, 2017).

known_gaps.title: Akvárium Klub
known_gaps.why: the underground venue beneath Erzsébet Square where Boiler Room Budapest's first two editions happened; reported to have suspended event planning for the first half of 2026, so it is named historically rather than given its own table row or image

known_gaps.why: the club has said only that it is moving near the Danube, with no confirmed address or date at the time of writing
